title: Synthesis, Structure, and Surface Adsorption Characteristics of a Polynuclear MnII,IV–YbIII Complex

material_class.structural_family: heptanuclear mixed-valence Mn4Yb3 bilayered 3d–4f coordination cluster

synthesis.procedure: Prepared under aerobic conditions. HL·SMe (0.068 g, 0.25 mmol) and Yb(OOCMe)3·xH2O (x ≈ 4; 0.106 g, 0.25 mmol) were dissolved together in 10 mL of MeCN/EtOH (1:1 v/v) in the presence of Et3N (0.08 mL, 0.58 mmol) under reflux. After stirring for 10 min, the orange mixture became clear and Mn(OOCMe)2·4H2O (0.082 g, 0.33 mmol) was added. The solution was stirred under reflux for 60 min. The resulting dark-orange solution was filtered and the filtrate stored in a closed vial under ambient conditions; overnight the color turned dark red-brown. Brown crystals suitable for X-ray diffraction were collected by filtration after 1 day, washed with ice-cold MeCN, and dried in air.
synthesis.time: 10 min (first step) then 60 min after Mn addition; crystals collected after 1 day
synthesis.vessel_or_method: two-step four-component reaction under reflux in air; filtrate stored in a closed vial under ambient conditions
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: hot/refluxed solution filtered; filtrate stored overnight; brown crystals collected by filtration after 1 day, washed with ice-cold MeCN, and dried in air

properties.summary: UV–vis absorption of 1 in MeCN is reported; no bulk magnetic susceptibility or related magnetic measurements are given. Surface STM/XPS studies address adsorption and electronic integrity rather than molecular magnetism or luminescence.

measurements.name: UV–vis absorption maximum (ε)
measurements.value: ε = 48000 (first λmax incompletely OCR’d), 322 nm (ε = 50600), 383 nm (ε = 38100)
